content:
Amid the recent wave of hardware price hikes and subscription fee increases sweeping the United States and other markets, Apple has now also raised iCloud+ prices across multiple countries. Details below.

Apple's Price Hike Wave Continues

Earlier this week, Apple raised subscription fees for Apple Music and Apple One in the United States and several other countries, and hiked iPhone prices in Japan by up to 11%.

This round of price hikes comes just days after Apple raised prices on MacBook, iPad, and other products in response to the ongoing memory shortage across the industry.

Apple has now announced a new round of iCloud+ price increases across multiple markets. Below are the adjusted iCloud+ prices taking effect today in affected markets:

Egypt (EGP)

  • 50GB: EGP 49.99 (was EGP 39.99)
  • 200GB: EGP 179.99 (was EGP 149.99)
  • 2TB: EGP 599.99 (was EGP 499.99)
  • 6TB: EGP 1,799.99 (was EGP 1,499.99)
  • 12TB: EGP 3,599.99 (was EGP 2,999.99)

Nigeria (NGN)

  • 50GB: ₦1,300 (was ₦900)
  • 200GB: ₦4,500 (was ₦2,900)
  • 2TB: ₦14,900 (was ₦9,900)
  • 6TB: ₦39,900 (was ₦26,900)
  • 12TB: ₦66,900 (was ₦44,900)

Turkey (TRY)

  • 50GB: TRY 49.99 (was TRY 39.99)
  • 200GB: TRY 169.99 (was TRY 129.99)
  • 2TB: TRY 549.99 (was TRY 399.99)
  • 6TB: TRY 1,699.99 (was TRY 1,299.99)
  • 12TB: TRY 3,399.99 (was TRY 2,499.99)

Indonesia (IDR)

  • 50GB: IDR 15,000 (unchanged)
  • 200GB: IDR 59,000 (was IDR 49,000)
  • 2TB: IDR 199,000 (was IDR 169,000)
  • 6TB: IDR 599,000 (was IDR 499,000)
  • 12TB: IDR 1,199,000 (was IDR 999,000)

Japan (JPY)

  • 50GB: ¥180 (was ¥150)
  • 200GB: ¥540 (was ¥450)
  • 2TB: ¥1,800 (was ¥1,500)
  • 6TB: ¥5,500 (was ¥4,500)
  • 12TB: ¥11,000 (was ¥9,000)

New Zealand (NZD)

  • 50GB: NZD 1.99 (was NZD 1.69)
  • 200GB: NZD 5.99 (was NZD 4.99)
  • 2TB: NZD 19.99 (was NZD 16.99)
  • 6TB: NZD 59.99 (was NZD 49.99)
  • 12TB: NZD 119.99 (was NZD 99.99)

Philippines (PHP)

  • 50GB: ₱59 (was ₱49)
  • 200GB: ₱199 (was ₱179)
  • 2TB: ₱699 (was ₱599)
  • 6TB: ₱1,990 (was ₱1,790)
  • 12TB: ₱3,990 (was ₱3,590)

Vietnam (VND)

  • 50GB: VND 25,000 (was VND 19,000)
  • 200GB: VND 89,000 (was VND 69,000)
  • 2TB: VND 299,000 (was VND 249,000)
  • 6TB: VND 899,000 (was VND 749,000)
  • 12TB: VND 1,799,000 (was VND 1,499,000)

Additionally, Apple has now added Laos, Mauritius, and the Republic of the Congo to regions where iCloud+ upgrades are "priced in U.S. dollars (USD), with prices potentially slightly higher due to value-added tax (VAT)."

The iCloud+ prices in these regions are as follows:

Mauritius (USD)

  • 50GB: $1.19
  • 200GB: $3.49
  • 2TB: $11.99
  • 6TB: $34.99
  • 12TB: $69.99

Republic of the Congo (USD)

  • 50GB: $1.19
  • 200GB: $3.49
  • 2TB: $11.99
  • 6TB: $34.99
  • 12TB: $69.99

Laos (USD)

  • 50GB: $0.99
  • 200GB: $3.29
  • 2TB: $10.99
  • 6TB: $32.99
  • 12TB: $64.99
